snippet.title: sYs - Save Your Soul | Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
sYs - Save Your Soul | Official Release Trailer

Escape the secret facility in this VR-only survival experience.

Play as an AI prototype navigating abandoned complexes. With no assistance, you must scavenge raw materials to craft your own tools, weapons, and complex machinery to survive haywire robots and find the exit.

LAUNCH OFFER: -15% OFF for a limited time!

Available now on Steam VR: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177000/sYs__Save_Your_Soul/
